claim_boundary: The polynomial-basis Karatsuba circuit is an exact stage representation on the same ONB curve and window factor base. Pinned controls and formula-size changes do not estimate unpinned PDP cost. A capped unpinned run is censored; natural yield, novel rank, complete N131 work and challenge permission remain unknown. CPU wall times are exploratory without host isolation.
method: Keep Q1494/Q1496's exact ONB leaf-window constraints, target-preimage selection, and balanced three-S3 chain. Transport each field-product operand into the independently verified same-field sparse polynomial basis; use recursively padded Karatsuba convolution, reduce by the archived irreducible modulus, and transport the result back to ONB through native XOR rows. Keep Q1496's one-thread CryptoMiniSat binary and Gaussian settings. Compare matched ordinary XCNF search cells, preserve the known N53 witness and N83 planted controls, and replay any model on the original curve.
success_gate: A useful solver improvement must independently verify an unpinned four-distinct-column relation on the frozen N53 ordinary public target, then on a known-representable N83 target and an ordinary N83 target. Record exact Boolean work, build/process/check phases, memory and all censored rows. A formula-size reduction or pinned SAT alone does not pass.
